# Dizid

> Dizid (https://dizid.com) is the one-person web development practice of Marc de Ruijter: a full-stack developer (Vue.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Netlify, PostgreSQL, Firebase) with 25+ years in IT and 20+ products shipped solo. He builds web apps, MVPs and AI features (Claude, GPT) for founders and small businesses, and finishes and hardens apps that were started with AI builders such as Lovable or Bolt. Fixed scope and a fixed price agreed before work starts. Dutch native, fluent English, invoices in EUR.

## Services and prices (as listed on https://dizid.com/hire)
- AI chat assistant for your website: €490 fixed, live in about 48 hours. Answers your customers' most common questions (up to about 30 FAQs) in English and/or Dutch, hands over to email or your contact form when it can't help, 1 website, 14 days of fixes.
- AI notice for your chatbot (EU AI Act Article 50): €390 fixed, about 1 day. Checks that visitors are told they are chatting with an AI and adds a clear notice, with before/after screenshots. Technical help, not legal advice.
- AI Integration Sprint: add Claude, GPT or custom AI features (chat, content generation, automation) to an existing web app. 1-2 weeks, from €3,000.
- MVP web app: a first working product with sign-in, database, payments and AI features. 2-4 weeks, from €8,000. Details: https://dizid.com/hire/mvp-development and https://dizid.com/fixed-price-mvp-for-non-technical-founders
- Full SaaS build: user management, billing, dashboards, AI features and production deployment. 4-8 weeks, from €15,000.
- How it works: you describe the project, you get a fixed-price proposal within 24 hours, then sprint-based delivery with weekly demos, ending deployed, documented and handed over.

## Good fit / not a fit
- Good fit: founders and business owners with an idea and no technical team; small businesses stuck on spreadsheets, manual work or an outdated website; anyone who wants one accountable person instead of an agency.
- Not a fit: enterprise builds that need a large multi-person team from day one.

## Live products Marc built and runs
- Foreground (https://foreground.info): shows which businesses ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok recommend for a customer's questions, and how to get named.
- HappyRoam Thailand (https://happyroam.travel): Thailand travel planner with visa help, onward tickets, 400+ places and AI itineraries.
- Wu Xing Zodiac (https://wuxingzodiac.me): Chinese zodiac and five-element site with a paid personal PDF reading.
- TestSwap (https://testswap.dev): indie developers test each other's apps for credits.
- TuneCraft (https://tunecraft.music): a personal music library and smart playlists on top of YouTube.
- ClientPilot (https://clientpilot.dev): AI-written client acquisition content for freelance developers.
- Remote Job Radar (https://nomadjobs.fun): a global remote-job aggregator with a daily email digest.
